title: Skills course marketplace
summary: A marketplace for experts to sell online courses.
whyTempting: Creators want to monetise expertise and learners want skills.
whyItFails: Commoditisation. Courses are abundant and discounted heavily. Completion rates. Most learners never finish. Creators leave. Successful creators go to their own platforms.
whatWouldChange: Cohort-based or outcome-tied learning; AI-personalised instruction.

attempts.notes: Bought for $1.5 billion in 2015 and folded into LinkedIn Learning.

attempts.outcome: Sold by Fiverr to CourseHorse, avoiding a shutdown

reasons.detail: Commoditisation: Courses are abundant and discounted heavily.
Completion rates: Most learners never finish.
Creators leave: Successful creators go to their own platforms.
